description: Land Title Settlement Department - Watuthala, Weththala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512000
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the Commissioner's determination regarding title to specific land parcels (Nos. 245 and 268) in Wattala. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, title classifications, and encumbrances/mortgages. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, with no government personnel or structural changes present.
